_comment: A PULL peer (ADR-012 §1.4): another PBS whose backups we pull a copy of, into pull/<name> on our datastore. We hold a read-only login on THEM; our own prune owns the copy, so they cannot delete what we keep. Created by: backup-manager peer add pull <name>. Credentials are prompted at onboarding and never stored here.
name: lars
_maxDepth_note: Optional (#796): how far below remoteNamespace the sync descends, 0 = that namespace only. Absent = PBS's default, every namespace it can list (a TAPPaaS buddy's non-propagating grant shows only its root anyway).
_tunnel_note: #796 (BUDDY.md): present when the pull runs over its own WireGuard tunnel, which we DIAL. remoteHost is then the tunnel's .1. Written by peer add pull --tunnel dial; e.g. {"role": "dial", "net": "10.255.2.0/30", "endpoint": "203.0.113.7:51830", "peerKey": "…", "mtu": 1340}
_location_note: Where THEIR PBS is: a location of this site (site-manager location list) — our copy of their data is their off-site; `backup-manager validate` compares it with the site's primary location. peer add --location names it, or --country/--city find or add it. EXAMPLE value.
_groupFilter_note: ADR-012 §3.6 subset (#389): pull only PART of the source. A PBS group-filter as a string or array of strings, e.g. "type:vm" or ["group:vm/101","group:vm/102"]. Empty/absent pulls everything.
